links.outcome: HealthBench rubric score of corpus-grounded RAG system versus frontier LLMs without that corpus
links.effect: VITA ranked first (51.9% vs GPT-5.4 46.1%) on 4,023 questions. On the 500-question subset with newer models and a neutral judge, VITA and GPT-5.5 were statistically indistinguishable; VITA's communication scores were lower.
links.quote: Here the gap narrowed to parity: VITA and GPT-5.5 were statistically indistinguishable on mean per-question score, while VITA led on points-weighted score and won the most questions.

unlisted_practices: Building clinical RAG on a curated corpus of local (India-specific) guidelines, antimicrobial resistance data and formulary constraints
Using a neutral judge model with no lineage overlap with the tested systems for LLM-as-judge benchmark scoring

screen.reason: The study benchmarks a specialized clinical RAG system against frontier foundation LLMs on a medical benchmark dataset (HealthBench). It does not test an organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
